Free, on-device dictation + meeting notes for Apple Silicon Macs (macOS 14+, 15+ recommended; Apple Intelligence features need macOS 26). Not notarized. First launch: open it once, then System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway (macOS 15+). The welcome window downloads the models (~490 MB, once) while you allow Microphone and Accessibility. Updates keep the same signature, so macOS keeps Microphone, Accessibility and System Audio Recording. Only if you ran a test build before: in System Settings > Privacy & Security, remove Scribe (–) from Microphone and Accessibility once, then open Scribe from Applications and allow again.
